rule_title: TTP 1136.001 - Local Admin Backdoor Account Created via net.exe or PowerShell
description: Detects creation of a local user account followed by addition to the local Administrators group, or direct password-expiry manipulation via wmic/Set-LocalUser. This TTP establishes a persistent local admin backdoor and is almost always malicious on production endpoints. Service-style account names (svc_*, admin_*, health*, helper*, support*) masquerading as legitimate accounts further raise fidelity. Detects both the Security EID 4720/4732 account lifecycle events and the Security EID 4688 / Sysmon EID 1 command line.
